QuestInfo.name: [Astra Secondary Weapon] An Emergency Arrest
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart requests that you come to Ereve as soon as possible. The Alliance caught someone who's either a criminal or maybe--just maybe--a great and unexpected boon.
QuestInfo.1: The culprit was found conducting illicit weapon deals at Henesys Market.
QuestInfo.2: The culprit gave Neinheart quite the headache and claimed to be some genius craftsman.
